tasks.short: Assess borrower finances, management and loan economics to estimate expected profitability.

steps.what: Retrieve loan terms and exposure from the lending system in {OTHER}.
Review financial statements in {DOCS} for completeness, periods and qualifications.
Enter statement figures and adjustments into a financial spread in {SPREADSHEET}.

loop.output: Financial spread with source locations, currencies, periods and unresolved adjustments.
loop.check: Validate field types and periods; tie subtotals and balance-sheet totals to source. Review adjustments separately.
loop.stop: One extraction and one correction pass per statement; unresolved figures go to the credit analyst.
loop.why_not_simpler: Use structured imports first. Variable statement layouts and notes require bounded document extraction.

steps.what: Calculate growth, ratios and loan profitability scenarios in {SPREADSHEET}.
Assess management quality, market position and forecast credibility using evidence in {DOCS}.
Select justified assumptions and determine expected loan profitability.
Write the profitability assessment in {DOCS} with supporting figures and caveats.

loop.input: Approved profitability conclusion, qualitative assessment and validated numerical workpapers.
loop.output: Profitability assessment with linked figures, assumptions and caveats.
loop.check: Insert figures deterministically; verify narrative references against workpapers. Analyst approves the assessment.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision per assessment; unsupported statements are removed or written manually.
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates handle tables. Explaining case-specific evidence and caveats requires variable prose.

steps.what: File the assessment against the loan in the lending system in {OTHER}.

tasks.design: A reusable calculator on {DATA_PLATFORM} combines loan terms from the lending system in {OTHER} with validated financial spreads; structured imports precede bounded extraction from {DOCS}. Deterministic scenarios feed an analyst's profitability conclusion, and a bounded drafting loop prepares the assessment in {DOCS}. Configured filing returns the approved assessment to {OTHER}; lending approval remains a separate decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Statement formats differ, assumptions sit in personal workbooks, and lending records lack convenient connections. Qualitative assessment cannot be reduced to arithmetic.
tasks.enabler_now: AI-assisted coding lowers the effort of building imports, calculators and validation screens. Bounded extraction and drafting can use source-linked workpapers without taking lending authority.
tasks.still_hard: Accounting adjustments, credible loss assumptions, management quality and changing market conditions still require judgement. Legacy access and validation may cost more than coding.
tasks.human_edge: Challenge optimistic forecasts, recognise weak management explanations and justify assumptions under uncertainty.

ambition.what: Monthly downside-profitability reviews for watch-list borrowers.

tasks.altitude: The week shifts from entering figures toward challenging forecasts and discussing weak economics. A delegated watch-list remit could add authority to recommend review timing and pricing changes; lending authority does not follow automatically.

reach.task: Set downside scenarios for deteriorating borrowers.
reach.learn: Loss calibration, scenario governance and limits of historical estimates.

reach.task: Review loan pricing against funding and servicing costs.
reach.learn: Cost allocation, funding assumptions and pricing approval limits.

evidence.claim: Financial ratios and loan-economics scenarios can use deterministic arithmetic; qualitative conclusions remain judgement.
Moody's Credit Memo drafts credit memos from spreads, deal documents and lender templates.
The digest describes a European-bank memo-drafting speed claim, but it does not establish savings for this implementation.

assumptions: Baseline is corporate lending at a mid-size European lender or financing business.
Today mixes lending-system screens, document review and financial spreads in {SPREADSHEET}.
The judgement-heavy priors outweigh the prior suggesting nearly complete automation.
Build ranges are estimates for one reusable pilot, not observed results; phases may overlap.
GDPR applies to personal data in borrower files. Natural-person lending requires separate assessment of automated-decision and EU AI Act obligations.
Access work includes security review and any employee consultation required by national rules.
The monthly watch-list ambition needs separate agreement on staffing and delegated authority.
unknowns: Whether the portfolio includes consumers or sole traders.
Available lending-system interfaces and existing profitability calculators.
Statement formats, languages and frequency of manual adjustments.
Approved funding, servicing-cost and expected-loss methods.
Current sign-off and lending-authority limits.
Applicable national rules and employee consultation arrangements.
research_questions: Which statement fields can come from structured feeds before document extraction?
Which accounting adjustments must always receive analyst review?
How should scenario assumptions be versioned and back-tested?
Which GDPR and EU AI Act requirements apply to the proposed use and borrower population?
new_work: Review extracted figures, source links and unresolved adjustments.
Maintain calculation rules, assumption versions and connector mappings.
Check drafted explanations against approved conclusions.
Investigate differences between forecast and realised profitability.
Schedule and prepare watch-list reviews if the ambition is adopted.

tasks.short: Compare borrower liquidity, profitability and credit history with relevant industry and geographic peers.

steps.what: Define suitable peer criteria using borrower information and policy in {DOCS}.
Retrieve peer financials and credit histories from benchmark and credit-bureau systems in {OTHER}.
Align periods, currencies and ratio definitions in {SPREADSHEET}, excluding unsuitable records.
Calculate borrower deviations, peer ranges and credit-history comparisons in {SPREADSHEET}.
Explain material deviations and limits of comparability in {DOCS}.
Prepare comparison charts and tables in {SPREADSHEET} for the credit assessment.

tasks.design: Connect licensed benchmark and credit-bureau feeds in {OTHER} to {DATA_PLATFORM}, with versioned peer criteria and deterministic normalisation. A configured {BI} view shows borrower deviations, data age and exclusions, while the analyst approves comparability exceptions and writes the benchmark conclusion in {DOCS}. Reuse the financial spread and loan file from the profitability workflow.
tasks.previous_blocker: Licensed feeds use different definitions, periods and industry classifications. Personal peer selections and copied tables make comparisons hard to reproduce.
tasks.enabler_now: AI-assisted coding makes feed adapters, mapping tables and comparison views cheaper to build. This task can gain substantially without a model loop.
tasks.still_hard: Sparse peer groups, accounting differences, stale private-company data and selection bias can make precise-looking comparisons misleading.
tasks.human_edge: Choose economically relevant peers and explain why an apparent outlier may be sound or risky.

ambition.what: Quarterly sector credit outlook for financial managers.

tasks.altitude: The week shifts toward testing peer relevance and explaining sector changes. The analyst could gain a mandate to propose sector review priorities, with credit-policy changes still approved by the credit manager.

reach.task: Maintain a reproducible sector benchmark view.
reach.learn: Dataset lineage, metric definitions and effective-date handling.
Portfolio aggregation, concentration limits and selection bias.

evidence.claim: Peer selection needs judgement, but normalisation, ratios, ranges and charts can use deterministic methods.
The digest contains no directly evidenced product or case for this complete peer-comparison workflow.

assumptions: Licensed structured peer data exists; acquiring a new dataset is outside the build estimate.
No automated credit decision follows from a percentile or peer comparison.
The judgement priors support retaining peer selection and interpretation; they do not require a model for arithmetic.
GDPR applies where credit histories contain personal data; data access must respect permitted purposes.
Consultation requirements depend on national rules and the nature of workplace changes.
The quarterly outlook requires additional editorial time beyond routine case comparisons.
unknowns: Licensed datasets, permitted reuse and feed access.
Required industry and geographic classifications.
Minimum acceptable peer coverage and data age.
Treatment of accounting standards, currencies and exceptional items.
Existing {BI} capacity and financial-spread quality.
Demand and ownership for a quarterly sector outlook.
research_questions: Which peer definitions produce stable and economically meaningful comparisons?
How should thin cohorts and missing credit histories be displayed?
Which normalisation exceptions require approval before comparison?
Can sector summaries be shared internally under existing data licences?
new_work: Review excluded records and unusual mapping exceptions.
Maintain metric definitions and industry mappings.
Monitor feed freshness, cohort coverage and licence restrictions.
Periodically challenge peer selection against realised outcomes.
Write and review the quarterly outlook if the service is adopted.

tasks.short: Discuss customer complaints, verify disputed transactions and arrange approved resolutions.

steps.what: Read the customer complaint in {EMAIL} and record its issue and transaction references.

loop.input: Customer complaint and permitted customer identifiers.
loop.output: Open complaint case with quoted issue, transaction references and missing-information flags.
loop.check: Retain the original message; validate reference formats. Uncertain customer matches remain unlinked for review.
loop.stop: One extraction per message; uncertain or unreadable content goes to manual intake.
loop.why_not_simpler: Structured forms use direct mapping. Free-text complaints express transaction references and issues inconsistently.

steps.what: Retrieve disputed entries from the lending system in {OTHER}.
Reconcile transaction evidence with payment evidence and loan terms in {SPREADSHEET}.
Discuss discrepancies and the customer's concerns by phone through {TELEPHONY}.
Prepare a justified resolution proposal in {DOCS}.
Approve financial corrections or concessions in {WORKFLOW}.
Send the customer an explanation and approved next steps through {EMAIL}.

loop.input: Approved resolution, verified transactions and customer clarification.
loop.output: Customer resolution message explaining the facts and approved next steps.
loop.check: Validate amounts and dates deterministically; analyst checks tone, disclosures and consistency before sending.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision per response; unclear facts or commitments require manual writing.
loop.why_not_simpler: Standard clauses are reusable, but disputed facts and the customer's concerns need tailored explanations.

steps.what: Record the resolution and remaining actions in {HELPDESK}.

tasks.design: A configured case flow in {HELPDESK} receives complaints from {EMAIL}, with bounded extraction for free text and deterministic retrieval from the lending system in {OTHER}. Reconciliation rules on {DATA_PLATFORM} prepare evidence for a human conversation and route concessions through {WORKFLOW}. A bounded loop drafts the customer response for approval, and {HELPDESK} records delivery and outstanding actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Complaint context sits in messages while transaction details sit in separate records. Manual investigation and sensitive customer discussions have often been treated as one indivisible task.
tasks.enabler_now: Connectors and reconciliation rules can assemble a reliable evidence pack. Bounded drafting can explain approved facts while the analyst retains the conversation and remedy judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Ambiguous payment references, contested contract interpretations, distressed customers and disputed evidence resist automatic resolution.
tasks.human_edge: Listen to the customer's account, distinguish a genuine discrepancy from a misunderstanding and choose a fair remedy.

ambition.what: Weekly selection of recurring complaint causes for process correction.

tasks.altitude: The analyst spends less time locating entries and more time resolving contested facts. A delegated improvement remit could let the analyst propose recurring-error fixes; concession and ledger-change limits remain explicit.

reach.learn: Posting references, reversal controls and evidence needed for corrections.

reach.task: Review complaint explanations and escalation handling.
reach.learn: Complaint deadlines, required disclosures and applicable national rules.

evidence.claim: Case intake, transaction retrieval and reconciliation can be automated separately from a sensitive customer conversation.
The digest provides no directly evidenced case for this complete complaint-resolution workflow.

assumptions: Today payment evidence and loan terms are available as case attachments or existing exports.
The conversation prior supports keeping consultation human; preparation and paperwork still offer savings.
Manager approval is required for corrections or concessions beyond delegated limits; local routing may differ.
Posting corrections and making refunds are adjacent actions, outside this consultation task.
Automatic case creation does not reject, prioritise adversely or close a complaint.
GDPR applies to complaint and transaction data. Recording calls is not required by this design.
Access planning includes any consultation required by national rules.
unknowns: Current complaint channels and case-management arrangements.
Availability and quality of payment evidence.
Delegated correction and concession limits.
Customer verification procedures and complaint deadlines.
Permitted message processing and retention arrangements.
Who would approve and implement recurring-error fixes.
research_questions: Which reconciliation rules reliably distinguish timing differences from incorrect postings?
Which complaint types need immediate specialist escalation?
How should evidence links and response drafts handle conflicting customer and ledger records?
What confirms completion before a case can close?
new_work: Resolve uncertain customer matches and incomplete complaint intake.
Review reconciliation exceptions and customer-response drafts.
Maintain approval routing and complaint templates.
Monitor delivery failures and unresolved corrective actions.
Review recurring causes weekly if the improvement remit is adopted.

tasks.short: Contact overdue customers, discuss repayment and track approved payment commitments.

steps.what: Retrieve overdue balances from the lending system in {OTHER}.
Review previous commitments, disputes and collection restrictions in {DOCS}.
Send a routine overdue reminder through {EMAIL}.
Call the customer through {TELEPHONY} to discuss overdue payments and circumstances.
Discuss a provisional repayment arrangement with the customer through {TELEPHONY}.
Approve the repayment arrangement within credit limits in {WORKFLOW}.
Record the approved plan and follow-up dates in the lending system in {OTHER}.
Check receipts against commitments in the lending system in {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Configure arrears queues and commitment tracking in the lending system in {OTHER}, with {WORKFLOW} routing repayment approvals. Deterministic checks suppress reminders for paid, disputed or restricted accounts, and {EMAIL} sends approved standard reminders within contact limits. The analyst handles difficult calls through {TELEPHONY}; missed commitments create an exception for a bill and account collector.
tasks.previous_blocker: Payment updates, disputes and contact notes are not always connected. Sensitive repayment discussions have discouraged automation of routine preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing collection configuration may already cover reminders and commitments. Small deterministic adapters can connect missing records without a model or autonomous agent.
tasks.still_hard: Repayment capacity, distress, disputed debts and suitable concessions require human discussion. Late payment feeds can cause inappropriate contact unless freshness checks work.
tasks.human_edge: Negotiate a credible arrangement, recognise hardship and know when to stop collection pressure or escalate.
tasks.altitude: This remains an occasional supplemental duty, with less preparation and recording. Decision rights stay the same; the credit analyst still escalates concessions and difficult collection cases.

reach.task: Choose follow-up action after a missed payment commitment.
reach.learn: Contact limits, hardship handling, dispute suppression and escalation thresholds.

reach.task: Resolve unmatched receipts before further collection contact.
reach.learn: Payment allocation, reference matching and posting cut-off times.

evidence.claim: Arrears queues, template reminders and payment-commitment tracking can use existing configuration and deterministic rules.
Sensitive debt discussions and concessions remain human work; the digest provides no directly evidenced collection implementation.

assumptions: This analyst handles occasional escalations rather than owning a high-volume collection operation.
Use shared collection capability; a bespoke application would be difficult to justify for this frequency.
Calls are more typical than visits for this baseline, despite the prior's high meetings-and-in-person share.
Routine reminders use approved templates, contact limits and current payment data; disputed and restricted accounts are excluded.
Narrative contact notes are reviewed by a person rather than automatically interpreted.
Repayment proposals remain provisional until authorised; unchanged contractual payment promises may need no manager approval.
GDPR and national collection and employment rules apply. Consultation needs depend on the actual workplace change.
unknowns: Whether existing lending-system configuration supports collections.
Actual escalation volume and division of work with collectors.
Payment-feed delay and dispute-flag reliability.
Permitted reminder channels, schedules and contact limits.
Repayment and concession approval thresholds.
Customer population and applicable national collection rules.
research_questions: Can the current system suppress contact immediately after payment or a dispute?
Which repayment arrangements change contractual terms and require additional approval?
What minimum payment-data freshness is needed before sending a reminder?
Which existing collection features can cover the whole occasional analyst workflow?
new_work: Review contact-plan exceptions and incomplete restriction flags.
Maintain reminder templates, suppression rules and approval limits.
Resolve stale payment feeds and unmatched receipts.
Handle missed commitments and delivery failures.
Periodically check contact history for duplicate or excessive reminders.

role.altitude: The credit analyst spends more time challenging borrower assumptions, choosing relevant peers and resolving contested facts. Numerical preparation and case paperwork shrink; broader review or improvement authority requires explicit delegation, while lending and concession limits remain defined.
reach: Financial risk specialist: prepare downside scenarios and sector review priorities.
Financial manager: explain loan economics and propose pricing reviews.
Business intelligence analyst: maintain reproducible borrower and peer comparisons.
Billing and posting clerk: provide evidence for approved transaction corrections.
Bill and account collector: hand over verified arrears and missed commitments.
Compliance officer: improve complaint explanations and escalation handling.
skills_to_grow: Loan profitability, loss assumptions and scenario validation.
Peer selection, data coverage and selection bias.
Clear evidence-based writing and customer explanations.
Connector validation, calculation-rule maintenance and exception monitoring.
GDPR, relevant EU AI Act obligations and applicable national rules.
role.ambitious_version: Run a borrower early-warning service combining monthly downside-profitability reviews with a quarterly sector credit outlook. Bring evidence-backed pricing and review recommendations to financial managers, and use recurring complaint causes to propose operational corrections.
